description: This PHP class defines the NodeStories model, handling database interactions related to node-story relationships, including fetching, listing, saving, deleting, and validation functionalities.

classes.name: NodeStories
classes.description: Model class representing node-stories relationships, providing data retrieval, manipulation, and validation functions.

methods.name: getNodeStory
methods.description: Fetches a specific node-story relationship based on node_id and stories_id.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of node-stories relationships with filtering, pagination, and localization support.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the Image instance related to the story's main image.

methods.name: getBackgroundImage
methods.description: Returns the Image instance for the story's background image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the node-story record into the database.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Deletes the node-story record from the database based on node_id and stories_id.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the node_id and stories_id properties before saving.
